Job description

Location: United States – Remote

Travel: 50–75%

Salary: $98,000–$128,000 based on experience

Employment Type: Full-Time

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Outside Sales professional from the water well and pump distribution industry to help expand our presence across the U.S. market.

The ideal candidate is currently working or had worked recently for a pump or water well distributor, regularly traveling throughout their territory and meeting directly with water well drillers, drilling companies, pump contractors, distributors, and end users.

This is not a position for someone who only has general B2B sales experience. We are looking for someone who knows the water well market from the field, understands the customers, knows the products, and has established industry relationships.

Key Responsibilities

Develop new business with water well distributors, drilling companies, pump contractors, and dealers.
Travel throughout an assigned territory to meet customers and develop relationships.
Build and maintain relationships with water well drillers and industry decision-makers.
Identify new distribution opportunities and expand existing accounts.
Promote water pumping solutions and related products.
Understand customer applications and help identify the appropriate pumping solution.
Develop new accounts while maintaining strong relationships with existing customers.
Monitor competitors, pricing, customer needs, and market opportunities.
Attend water well, groundwater, irrigation, and pump industry trade shows.
Work closely with management and technical teams to support customer requirements.
Maintain accurate sales activity, opportunities, and forecasts.
Help expand market share throughout the United States.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate will:

Currently or recently worked in outside sales for a water well, pump, or related distributor.
Have direct experience calling on water well drilling companies.
Regularly travel and make face-to-face customer visits.
Understand the water well and groundwater market inside and out.
Have established relationships with drillers, pump contractors, distributors, and dealers.
Understand submersible pumps and water well applications.
Be comfortable discussing technical products with experienced industry professionals.
Have a proven history of generating sales and developing new accounts.
Be willing to travel 50–75% throughout the United States.

Preferred Industry Experience

Water well pumps
Submersible pumps
Groundwater equipment
Pump distribution
Water well drilling
Irrigation
Agricultural pumping
Solar pumping systems
Pump controls and VFDs
Water treatment and related equipment
